newsitem.title: ITALY: FORECAST-Italy seen issuing 16 trln lire Bots.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Italy seen issuing 16 trln lire Bots.

text.p: The Italian Treasury is likely to offer a total 16.0 trillion lire worth of short-term bills (Bots) at its mid-month auction, against 17.25 trillion lire worth of paper expiring, economists said.

Forecasts ranged from a minimum of 14.5 trillion lire worth of Bots to an upper limit of 16.5 trillion while for zero-coupon certificates (Ctzs), analysts polled by Reuters expected a new tranche worth 2.5 trillion at the auctions on November 12.

"Between January and October the net total issues on the internal market and of Eurobonds equalled 101 trillion compared with a total deficit of 114 trillion," Banca Commerciale Italian said in a research note.
"The Treasury will continue in its policy of limiting Bot issues, using as an alternative its liquidity account with the Bank of Italy and Ctz issues," said Paolo Cipollone of Credito Italiano.
"In any case the reduction in new emissions will be less marked than that seen in the last auction when expiries exceeded new issues by 3.5 trillion," an analyst with Banca di Roma said.
The Treasury will announce the amount on offer on Thursday.
